originStory.title: Why I Started Coaching
originStory.story: After years of creating courses, kits, and communities, I kept receiving the same message: 'Your content is great, but I'm still stuck on MY specific situation.' I realized that even the best courses can't diagnose individual challenges. Some people don't need more information—they need someone to look at THEIR mess and help them see the patterns. Someone who's actually lived this for decades, not just theorized about it. That's why I started coaching. Not to replace self-learning, but to accelerate it. One focused hour with an expert can shortcut months of trial-and-error.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years of Real Practice
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not Theory. Lived Experience.
creatorJourney.story: I've been passionate about Knowledge Management since the early 2000s. As a software architect, author, content creator, and entrepreneur, all while raising three kids, I needed systems that actually work under pressure. I've used dozens of tools, tested countless methods, and refined my approach through real-world chaos. I created the Obsidian Starter Kit, the Knowledge Worker Kit, the PKM Library, and the Knowii Community. I've published 10,000+ notes, written books, and helped hundreds of people build their own systems. This isn't academic knowledge. It's battle-tested practice.
struggles: Started with scattered notes across dozens of tools
Spent years in trial-and-error before finding what works
Had to build systems that work with a busy family life

methodology.title: How I Coach
methodology.subtitle: First Principles, Not Copy-Paste

steps.title: Listen and Diagnose
steps.description: I start by understanding YOUR situation. Your work, your goals, your challenges, and what you've already tried. No assumptions.

steps.title: Apply First Principles
steps.description: Instead of prescribing my system, I help you understand WHY certain approaches work. This lets you build something that fits YOUR reality.

steps.title: Design Your System
steps.description: Together, we sketch out YOUR system. Not a copy of mine. Tool-agnostic principles that work whether you use Obsidian, Notion, or anything else.

steps.title: Create Action Plan
steps.description: You leave with specific, immediate next steps. Not vague advice. Concrete actions you can take today.

methodology.philosophy: I don't believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. The best PKM system is one designed for YOUR life, built on proven principles, and simple enough that you'll actually use it.
